ALL-ORDER COLLECTIVE RESPONSE WITH ACQUIRED VARIANCE AND WORK
Research construction, 1 November 2026

This note contains the root construction. The full all-k polynomial proof and
independent exact checks are in ../interacting/positive_dual_potential.txt.
Existing building blocks and qualifications are retained in ../alternative/
BARW_AUDIT.txt. Historical priority and external review are not established.

1. Actual microscopic input and physical response

On the periodic n-site chain, n>=4, sigma_i is +/-1 and

  pi(sigma) proportional to exp[J sum_i sigma_i sigma_(i+1)],
  gamma=tanh(2J), t=tanh J,
  w_i(sigma)=(1-b sigma_(i-1)sigma_(i+1))/2
             *[1-gamma sigma_i(sigma_(i-1)+sigma_(i+1))/2].

Here 0<b<1/2, with gamma(1-b)>b sufficient for the uniform bounds below.
The prefactor is independent of sigma_i, so detailed balance is unchanged.
Every site's kinetics is modified. Its contrast is (1+b)/(1-b), fixed as n
grows. The zero-field symmetry and this particular neighbor dependence are
essential to the positive representation proved here.

Let K=-L be the positive generator, M=sum_i sigma_i, and

  chi=<M,K^+ M>_pi=integral_0^infinity Cov_pi(M(0),M(s)) ds.

This is the full target response, not a finite interaction-order coefficient.
The computed critical family is

  b=1/3, exp(2J)=n,
  t=(n-1)/(n+1), gamma=(n^2-1)/(n^2+1).

Its correlation length is order n; Var(M) is order n^2. The Glauber reference
has KM=(1-gamma)M. Form comparison by 1-b and 1+b proves chi/Var(M) is order
n^2 in the target, so M overlaps the collective slow dynamics. The small
spectral scale is not imposed through heterogeneous physical clocks.

All executable inputs for this family are rational. The earlier model with
kinetic multipliers A_same=1,A_opposite=2 is exactly 3/2 times this generator.
Its response is 2/3 of the response in this note. Comparisons must rescale time.

2. Exact positive representation of the target, at every order

For an odd subset S, phi_S=product_(i in S) sigma_i. Direct multiplication gives

  K phi_S=|S| phi_S
    -a sum_(i in S, +/-) phi_(S xor {i,i+/-1})
    -b sum_(i in S) phi_(S xor {i-1,i+1}),
  a=gamma(1-b)/2, kappa=(1-b)(1-gamma).

Thus the dual is a real positive branching-annihilating process: each particle
hops in either direction at rate a and toggles both neighbors at rate b;
overlaps annihilate. The residual killing rate is kappa |S|

1 November 2026

Scope and role
--------------
This file preserves the independent alternative construction and audit. The
parent owns the central all-order response synthesis and executable sampler.
The interacting agent owns the completed ordinary combinatorial proofs of the
gap identities. Earlier signed-dual and transport work is not overwritten.

The example is the periodic n-site ferromagnetic Ising chain, n>=4, with

 w_i(sigma) = (1-b L R)/2 * [1-gamma sigma_i(L+R)/2],
 L=sigma_(i-1), R=sigma_(i+1), 0<b<gamma(1-b).

The executed critical family has b=1/3, exp(2J)=n,
 gamma=(n^2-1)/(n^2+1), t=tanh(J)=(n-1)/(n+1).
The response is chi=<M,K^+M>, M=sum_i sigma_i, at the actual Gibbs equilibrium.
The entire nonlinear generator is retained. No number of dual particles,
branching order, path duration or spatial radius is truncated.

1. Exact positive dual and ordinary regeneration
------------------------------------------------
For odd S, phi_S=product_(i in S) sigma_i. Put

 a=gamma(1-b)/2, kappa=(1-b)(1-gamma), N=|S|.

            -a sum_(i in S) [phi_(S xor {i,i-1})+phi_(S xor {i,i+1})]
            -b sum_(i in S) phi_(S xor {i-1,i+1}).

Thus the dual hops each particle left/right at rate a, toggles its two neighbors
at rate b, and is killed at rate kappa N. Odd parity is preserved by live moves.
Let Kint be the positive generator of these live moves. Let V(S)=<M,phi_S> and
V1=V({0}); Var(M)=n V1.

Starting at packed triple T={0,1,2}, stop the LIVE dual at its first singleton
time tau. Set A_s=integral_0^s N_r dr. Ordinary renewal, integrating singleton
waiting and translation exactly, gives

waited for. This alone does NOT establish useful variance. Direct excursion
second moments can grow with n. Positive recurrence is insufficient to infer
dimension-independent second moments.
